steps.npc: Although archers like myself like to keep distance from our enemies, it's always good to have a bit of protection.

steps.player: Very sensible! Did you make these yourself?

steps.npc: I am a bit of a craftsman, I indeed made all these shields.
It's very simple! First you'll need to be skilled in crafting and fletching, the exact details you can find in your skill guide.
For every shield, you'll require some tools! A knife for fletching the wood and a hammer for crafting the shield.
As for resources, you'll need 2 logs, 2 pieces of tanned leather and 15 nails.

steps.player: Where can I find out more information about the resources needed?

steps.npc: I have a flyer! It details all the shields and the resources needed for them.

steps.player: May I have a resource flyer?

steps.text: If the player doesn't have a leather shields flyer in their inventory:

steps.npc: Of course! The more you know, the better!

steps.text: The Shield Master hands you 'Leather Shields - Resource information flyer'.
If the player already has a leather shields flyer in their inventory:

steps.npc: You already have a flyer, I've only so many left.
My name is William! And I'll tell you this, I'm the best crossbowman this side of White Wolf Mountain.

steps.player: Who's better than you on the other side of the mountain?

steps.npc: Couldn't tell you that myself, never been there.

steps.player: Oh... How did you come across that crossbow then?

steps.npc: Oh this? Some wandering merchant came by recently, told me it was the stealthiest crossbow there was.
Well, he told me it was his last one too, so I figured I'd give it a try.

steps.player: It was nice meeting you William.
